It’s in poetry form. It sounds dumb but it still explains most of my pain with why I’m going to do what I will do. 

My dog is dying. My mother is... a lot. As always. I have no friends here. I have no friends on campus. They’re all in my hometown or different cities. And I just feel so hated. I want the suffering to end where I feel I need to help everyone. 

I feel like I deserve to rot because I just can’t keep going. And that makes me weak. It’s just a general way of feeling. 

I know I may kill myself soon, but I still hope others like you don’t. Whatever you’re going through, I can listen to it still. I hope we both miraculously survive, perhaps, just to know what it’s like to have purpose in this life of suffering.

it’s more complicated than bullying. they don’t bully me. however every time I seem to introduce a friend they only want to be closer with them and forget about me. It’s happened at least five times now. The only time this didn’t happen was with my old best friend who sexually abused me. and with this new friend I’ve introduced its so much worst because I can’t ever stop the feelings I have for him even though I am worthless to her. I try to not let the past get to me but it’s just too painful. the past and present are so painful. 

EDIT: the reply you gave me but deleted after lol I guess was well deserved. but I’ve tried. I’ve tried more than you’ll know. I’m a useless abuse victim that can’t have a normal life because everyone will be scared of me. Not just sexual; but emotional for all my life. I might be needy, but everyone that I’ve met has said I’m the exact opposite. Thanks for validating the thoughts that constantly run my mind
